reminder.summary: Native Swift CLI for Apple Reminders with full EventKit integration.
reminder.lead: Native macOS command-line interface for Apple Reminders with full EventKit integration, instant execution, and zero external runtime dependencies.

examples.comment: Create a reminder in default list

capabilities: Direct EventKit sync with iCloud & Apple Reminders
Native compiled Swift binary — sub-20ms startup
Scriptable plain-text output for shell pipelines
Automatic quarantine removal during brew install
reminder.troubleshooting:
On first run, macOS prompts Terminal for Reminders access — choose Allow.

If macOS still flags the binary:
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine "$(brew --prefix)/bin/reminder"

corenote.summary: CLI frontend to Apple Notes via direct local SQLite access.
corenote.lead: Fast command-line interface to your local Apple Notes database via direct read-safe SQLite access — search, inspect, and pipe notes straight from your terminal.

examples.comment: Print a note body to stdout

capabilities: Direct local SQLite access to Apple Notes store
Fast offline search without opening Notes.app
Clean plain-text output for grep, jq, and scripts
Automatic quarantine removal during brew install
corenote.troubleshooting:
macOS requires Full Disk Access for your terminal app to read the local Apple Notes SQLite database (System Settings → Privacy & Security → Full Disk Access).

If macOS still flags the binary:
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine "$(brew --prefix)/bin/corenote"
